# Reified documentation

Start at `/getting-started/`: one complete transaction — a model declaration, untrusted input parsed into it,
accumulated path-aware failures, and a JSON codec derived from the same declaration.

Reified contains four independent documentation entry points. Load only the context for the product being used:

- Result composition, `result { }`, and accumulating builders: `/result/llms.txt`
- Values — Constraint, Refinements, and Parse: `/values/llms.txt`
- Data, structured fixtures, immutable edits, comparisons, and produced-data matching: `/data/llms.txt`
- Schema, parsing, codecs, contracts, and path-aware diagnostics: `/schema/llms.txt`

Product documentation starts at `/result/`, `/values/`, `/data/`, and `/schema/`.
Values is a navigation grouping over three independently installable packages; there is no `Reified.Values` package.

`Reified` is an umbrella package that installs every runtime package at once. It adds no API of its own: every
type still comes from the package documented above.

Effects, services, concurrency, and hosting are not part of Reified. They live in Axial
(https://github.com/adz/Axial), whose optional server adapters execute Reified HTTP contracts.
